notes: Only specified meaning and formulation IDs are consolidated; no similarity-based deletion.

form.ab260940ea9c523d.connected-componen.text: A connected component of a topological space X is a nonempty connected subset of X that is maximal under inclusion among connected subsets of X.
form.ab260940ea9c523d.connected-componen.reason: Stacks §5.7 explicitly requires connected spaces/subsets to be nonempty. Under mathDef's broader no-separation meaning the empty subset is connected, so make nonemptiness explicit to preserve the Stacks maximal-subset component definition when X is empty.
form.ab260940ea9c523d.connected-componen.original_text: A connected component of a topological space X is a connected subset maximal under inclusion among connected subsets of X.
form.ab260940ea9c523d.connected-componen.audit_note: The added nonempty condition preserves the empty-space behavior: empty X has no connected components.
